title: Prism Axis
description: Axis configuration for a position channel.

axis.description: Axis options including title, ticks, grid, and label placement. Null suppresses the axis entirely (no domain line, ticks, labels, title or grid) and releases the padding its side reserved — omitting the `axis` key instead keeps the default axis.

orient.description: Side of the chart on which the axis appears.

tick_size.description: Tick mark length in pixels. Overrides the theme's --prism-axis-tick-size token; minor ticks stay proportionally shorter.

labels.description: Whether to draw tick labels. False suppresses only the labels — the tick marks, domain line, grid and title stay — and releases the padding they reserved.

label_angle.description: Rotation angle in degrees for tick labels.

label_padding.description: Gap between the axis line and its tick labels in pixels. Overrides the theme's --prism-axis-label-padding token.

label_limit.description: Maximum allowed label width in pixels before the label is truncated with an ellipsis. 0 means no limit.

domain.description: Whether to draw the axis domain line. False suppresses only that line; it sits on the plot edge and reserves no padding.

ticks.description: Whether to draw tick marks. False suppresses only the marks — the labels derived from the same tick positions stay — and releases the padding they reserved.

zindex.description: Stacking order relative to the marks: 0 (the default) draws the axis and its grid lines behind them, any positive value draws them in front.
